 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 13-02-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.

This application has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure on behalf of petitioner for quashing the order dated 19.10.2022 passed by learned J.M. 1st Class, Siwan in Complaint Case No. 1150 (C) of 2022.
By the said order, the learned Magistrate took cognizance of offence under Sections 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code against all the three accused persons including this petitioner.

3. The prosecution case, in short, is that the complainant filed a complaint case, bearing no. 1150 (C)
of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30813 of 2023(2) dt.13-02-2024 2022 under Sections 313, 323,
504, 498A, 406/34 of the Indian Penal Code against her husband (petitioner herein), her father- in-law and her mother-in-law stating therein that she got married with this petitioner on 21.06.2010 Ashok Kumar @ Ashok Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156290925/

sentences.text: at Mathura and at the time of marriage, her father had given Rs. 10 lacs cash, jewellery, clothes and furniture, but after few months, her father-in-law and mother-in-law started torturing her and instigated petitioner not to live with the complainant.

It is further alleged that in the year 2013,
when complaint was two months' pregnant, her mother-in-law gave her some medicine, which caused her miscarriage.
It is further alleged that on 16.11.2021, when father of complainant passed away and complainant came to her maika to attend the final rites, this petitioner assaulted her and left her in her maika.

It is lastly alleged in the complaint petition that on 01.06.2022, the accused persons, after keeping her clothes, jewelleries and other streedhan, assaulted the complainant and threw her out of the matrimonial house, resulting in lodging of the present complaint case.

4. It is submitted on behalf of petitioner that petitioner has earlier filed a matrimonial case, vide Matrimonial (Divorce) Case No. 922 of 2021, on 12.08.2021 for grant of decree of divorce, which is at present pending in the Court of learned Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30813 of 2023(2)
dt.13-02-2024 Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna and it is only when the complainant got information about filing of aforesaid matrimonial case, she got infuriated and filed the present complaint case out of vengeance.
5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the materials available on record.
From bare perusal of the complaint petition, it is apparent that there is specific and direct allegation against this petitioner and others of committing torture and harassment to the complainant.
The grounds, which have been raised by petitioner, are his defence, which can only be considered by leading evidence.
I do not find illegality or irregularity in the impugned order warranting any interference by this Court.
6. Accordingly, this application is dismissed.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
